description: This file defines the Total class within the Opencart catalog model extension, responsible for adding total information to the cart, including the total value, and is typically called during total calculations.

classes.name: Total
classes.description: Class responsible for calculating and adding the total amount to the totals array during checkout processing.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Adds a total entry to the totals array, including title, value, and sort order, using language and configuration settings.
